StorySubmission.title: StorySubmission
StorySubmission.description: A community journal story submission awaiting coordinator review or approved for public display.

author.description: Display name chosen by the contributor, or Anonymous.

isAnonymous.description: Whether the contributor chose to publish anonymously.

date.description: Display month and year when the story was submitted.

content.description: Full text of the community reflection.

status.description: Moderation workflow status; public submissions always start as pending.

consentGiven.description: Explicit informed consent for review and publication.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded on initial submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded on creation and moderation updates.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized team coordinator who can review, approve, reject, or delete submitted journal stories.

email.description: Verified email address of the coordinator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the coordinator entry was created.

/story_submissions/{storyId}.description: Community journal submissions. Visitors can create pending stories and read approved stories; verified coordinators can list pending stories, approve, reject, or delete them.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Additional verified coordinator accounts authorized to moderate journal submissions.
